messages:
maya: Quick heads up 9: renewal for SolaraOps hit our queue. They want Net60 terms and to move 10 seats into Dedicated capacity. Attached the quote: https://drive.redwood/solara/renewal_q2_2026.xlsx
sam: Net60 is out of our normal offering. who approved it on their side last year?
eli: Last year's contract was Net30. Finance flagged Net60 requires senior approval (policy 3.2).
maya: Can we propose Net45 as a middle ground? Client prefers longer terms but we can ask for an upfront deposit. Need to finalize before Friday so procurement can generate PO.
finance: Net45 only if they agree to 70% upfront for the first billing period, and a billing contact on file. Otherwise stick to Net30.
procurement-bot: DocuSign envelope #7890 created by maya  status: sent  recipients: client-admin@solara.com
maya: Client says their SSO blocks DocuSign popup. They're trying a personal browser. If that's still blocked they'll need an alternate signing flow.
Solara Admin (external): Trying Chrome incognito now, getting "verification failed" on signer step.
eli: If DocuSign keeps failing, offer two options: 1) wet signature (scan + email) or 2) white-glove execution via our CSM on a Zoom share. Which is faster for them?
maya: Client prefers wet-signature if the SSO wont allow pop-ups. Re-sent envelope with ID check disabled. Also uploaded a short addendum draft for Net45 + 70% upfront.
legal: Draft attached and reviewed. We'll add a clause that Dedicated seats are billed at the committed rate and any overage billed monthly. ETA to attach to envelope: 11:30 PT.
alex (account-exec): Given health metrics and usage growth, I'm okay with Net45 + 70% upfront. Need finance confirmation and legal to bind the addendum before we proceed.
finance: Confirmed, once signed we'll issue an invoice that includes PO reference + wire instructions. Also note: billing entity mismatch  client wants invoice to "Solara UK Ltd" but contract uses "Solara Global Inc." Need VAT and tax ID to remap billing.
maya: VAT/tax ID added to ticket CS-9876 and linked here: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/CS-9876 (commented).
eli: Logged update in the renewal tracker: status = "awaiting signature (SSO hiccup)"; risk = "medium-high"; steward = maya.
maya: I'll follow up with the client hourly until we have a signed addendum. If DocuSign fails after 4pm we'll switch to wet-signature and scan intake.
account-exec: Please escalate to me if the client pushes for Net60 again. I will take the exec call.
maya: Noted. Will update once signature landed or wet-sign route initiated. :spiral_calendar_pad:
_meta: Generated per agents.md: Slack thread JSON for customer-success renewal execution (pricing, term change, procurement, signature issues).
